name: Simplify Mesh
description: Removes triangles from the active piece while keeping its shape. Open edges, face-group borders and fully masked vertices stay put. Reports progress and can be stopped.

params.label: Remove (%)
params.help: How much of the triangle count to try to remove. The shape is kept; this is not a live preview, because it can take a moment.

params.label: Keep open edges
params.help: Vertices on a hole or an outer edge stay where they are, and those edges are not deleted.

params.label: Keep group borders
params.help: The edge between two face groups is left in place.

params.label: Keep fully masked
params.help: A fully masked vertex is not moved.

params.text: Mask, color, face groups and hidden faces of what remains are kept. Subdivision levels are cleared; Undo restores them. A very large piece is only partly simplified, so you can run it again.
